content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to use a [product_name] together with a bus module without connecting a [version_no] controller?
Hi [user_name], Could you clarify what you mean by 'Bus module'?
I'm referring to ASI or EIB/KNX modules. Do I need a [version_no] controller to operate with one of these systems?

Hi [user_name], If you use the ASI module, the [product_name] acts as a slave on the ASI bus, meaning an ASI master is required. This master could be a [version_no] controller. For the EIB module, a [version_no] controller is not necessary. More details can be found in the manual: [url]. Additional information may also be available there.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want information on whether [product_name] modules can be integrated with bus communication modules like ASI or EIB/KNX without needing a [version_no] controller. Initial ambiguity about module types is resolved through further clarification, revealing a demand for documentation that more clearly outlines compatibility and system requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate using [product_name] modules with ASI or EIB/KNX communication modules independently of a [version_no] controller. They expect clear guidance on interoperability and the minimum system necessary for operation.
